Subject: Production 429s starting 2025-06-02 — urgent

Jordan —

We started seeing a sharp increase in 429s and 500-level latency from Redwood for our production tenant since ~2025-06-02 22:30 UTC. This is impacting two of our provider partners; pages are firing and our customers are seeing timeouts.

Attached are the request/response snippets and a short timeline (clearsight-incident-logs.txt). We did not change traffic pattern — traffic increased ~30% due to a scheduled campaign but that should have been in the normal operating range per our SLA.

We need immediate triage and either a temporary removal of throttling or a rollback to the prior policy. Please advise next steps and a point of contact for engineering.

— Elena Martin

Subject: Re: Production 429s starting 2025-06-02 — urgent

Jordan / Monica —

On quick triage: tenant ClearSight (tenant id: cs-6721) was migrated to a new burst/quota policy last week (deploy 2025-05-30). The new window math reduces the effective burst tokens at high QPS when the moving-window refill aligns poorly with their short, high-frequency bursts — this manifests as immediate 429s under a 20–40% traffic uptick.

Action I recommend now (short order):
1) Push a temporary policy override to restore the previous burst window for cs-6721 (I can push this in ~10–15m).
2) Increase tenant quota by 25% for 24 hours to buy breathing room while we root cause.
3) Open INF-4927 for the long-term fix (policy evaluation + more conservative defaults for tenant migrations).

I've captured short notes (sre-investigation-notes.md). If leadership approves a 24h exception, we can implement immediately and monitor.

— Karthik
SRE, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick triage. Approve the temporary policy override + 24h quota bump for Clearsight to prevent customer impact. Please document the exception (use temporary-exception-form.pdf) and tag INF-4927. Do not extend beyond 24 hours without my explicit written approval.

We need:
- Karthik: implement override and post implementation telemetry checks (p95 latency, 429 rate, token header changes) and update the ticket within 2 hours.
- Monica/Jordan: confirm customer-facing language and secure procurement sign-off for any billing exposure.
- Grace: coordinate an engineering postmortem for the migration flow (why migration changed effective burst) and provide a mitigation plan within 72 hours.
